leave_parental_paid_009.evidence: A parental leave of absence for up to thirty (30) workdays shall be granted upon request for the purpose of childbearing and/or child rearing. Benefit entitlement for eligible employees consists of: a. Gross pay during this time will be 40 percent of wages;

leave_pregnancy_disability_010.evidence: If not on parental leave of absence, any portion of an educator's absence from work because of a medical disability connected with or resulting from her pregnancy may be charged to her available sick leave.

leave_adoption_childcare_011.evidence: Paid parental leave is a benefit that provides paid leave for an eligible employee to bond with his or her newborn, adopted child, or foster child.

leave_fmla_012.evidence: The parental leave must run concurrently to the FMLA if the employee is eligible for FMLA.
